canonical_statement: Produce a simple graph on 69 labelled vertices in which every vertex has degree 20, every adjacent pair has exactly 7 common neighbors, and every nonadjacent pair has exactly 5 common neighbors. Any accepted graph resolves the positive existence side of the unrestricted strongly regular graph parameter question.
success_criterion: amf.srg692075.exact.v1 verifies exactly 690 canonical edges, every degree, and all 2346 pairwise common-neighbor counts and accepts. Current database/novelty review remains separate.
partial_progress_criterion: Retain new feasible orbit matrices, rigorous necessary conditions, or certified exclusion of a predeclared mathematically meaningful symmetry class without claiming global nonexistence.
stop_conditions: A current SRG table or paper resolves the parameter set.
The search only repeats a previously excluded group action without a new reduction.
The separately approved experiment budget is exhausted.
